name: Milton
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Milton, NY
blurb: Milton Landing, on the west bank between New Hamburg and Poughkeepsie, on a straight and comparatively narrow reach of river.

tide.label: NOAA 8518945 Poughkeepsie
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8518945 at Poughkeepsie, about three miles upriver.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.

current.label: NOAA HUR0620_11 Mid-Hudson Bridge
current.note: Current from NOAA station HUR0620_11 (Mid-Hudson Suspension Bridge), about three miles upriver, at the 16 ft bin nearest the surface.
